title: Move the three untested inline workflow step bodies into scripts/ci with self-tests
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95YovdFSHTxz132KjPG4TAa)_
Part of #26086

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：三个只在「没有 PR 能触发的事件」上跑的工作流步骤(定时全量红卡、nightly 红卡、看板备份上传 R2)，把内联主体搬进 `scripts/ci/`，每个都配了离线自测，并接进 `lint-ci-engine` 道。
- 为什么改：这三段主体原来没有任何测试能碰到，第一次执行就是线上真跑。卡上其余 17 个超 80 行的主体，大多已经有门禁在读它的原样字节；release.yml 的 3 步有信任边界，不能搬。逐个原因见下文 Acceptance notes。
- 风险与回滚：行为不变。github-script 步骤保留原来的 token、`retries:` 和权限，只是改成 import 模块后薄调用；bash 主体逐字节不变。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs`(调用和回调接线)、`scripts/ci/nightly-tiers-card.mjs`、`.github/workflows/lint.yml` 新增的那一步。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs --self-test && node scripts/ci/nightly-tiers-card.mjs --self-test && bash scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.selftest.sh`，三行 ✓,共 7 + 7 + 5 个用例。
- 需要你做的：这是 Tier H(改 `.github/workflows/**`),需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS(os-zhuang 或 hotlong)批准；PR 1 的范围(只搬没有测试台的部分，还是照卡全搬)在项目线程里等 Steve 裁决。

## What changes

Three inline step bodies that no test reached move into `scripts/ci/`, each with an offline self-test:

| Workflow step | Lines moved | New home | Self-test |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` · File or refresh the card (github-script) | 121 | `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs` · `fileCardStep` | 7 cases |
| `test-nightly-tiers.yml` · File or refresh the card (github-script) | 158 | `scripts/ci/nightly-tiers-card.mjs` · `fileNightlyCard` | 7 cases |
| `board-snapshot.yml` · Upload the archive to R2 (run) | 125 | `scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.sh` | `scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.selftest.sh`, 5 cases / 27 checks |

- **github-script bodies keep their step.** The step now does `await import(GITHUB_WORKSPACE + '/scripts/ci/X.mjs')` and calls the exported function with the same `github` / `context` / `core`. That keeps the token, the `retries:` / `retry-exempt-status-codes:` policy and the job's `permissions:` exactly as they were. It follows `scheduled-full-run-card.yml`'s existing import of `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs`. This is a deliberate deviation from the card's literal "the YAML step becomes `node scripts/ci/X.mjs`": a bare `node` step would need its own octokit, token plumbing and retry policy, which is a behaviour change. Both jobs already check out the repository.
- **The bash body moves byte for byte.** `scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.sh` is the inline block plus a header and the `set -e` that GitHub's default `bash -e {0}` shell supplied. `cmp` against the YAML-parsed block is identical. The step keeps its `env:` and runs `bash scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.sh`.
- **Spelling changes inside the moved JS, and only these:** `require('fs')` / `require('path')` became static imports. `process.env` became an `env` parameter that defaults to `process.env`. The two `new Date()` reads that stamp a body became an injectable `now` that defaults to `new Date()`. The import of `scheduled-full-run.mjs` became static.
- **Wiring:** one new gate step in `lint-ci-engine`, `Moved workflow step bodies self-test` (with an `id:` and `continue-on-error: true`, so the lane verdict reads it), runs all three self-tests through the repo's `run_self_test` collector, so one red does not hide the others.
- **Adoption lists:** `board-snapshot.yml`'s header and `scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs`'s docblock both said "copy FOUR files". The R2 step now needs a fifth, so both lists name it. That is the one prose edit, and it is the card's own carve-out: a literal the touched step makes false.
- **Found while moving:** the root `.gitignore` ignores `test-*.mjs`, so the nightly module could not be named `test-nightly-tiers-card.mjs`. Its first push silently left it out, and it is now `nightly-tiers-card.mjs`.

## Tests

Behaviour preservation was checked before each move, against the inline bodies at `6390fe52` (main when this branch was cut):

- **github-script bodies:** a one-off harness ran the inline body extracted from the YAML (compiled the way `actions/github-script` compiles it) and then the module, under identical doubles, files and a frozen clock. It recorded every API call with its full parameters, bodies included, and every `core` call. The traces are identical: `scheduled-full-run-card` 7/7 scenarios, `nightly-tiers-card` 7/7. The committed self-tests pin the values taken from those traces. For the scheduled card the body is pinned as exact `renderBody(...)` arguments, so a wording change in `scheduled-full-run.mjs` does not red this file. For the nightly card it is pinned as the SHA-256 of the inline body's bytes.
- **bash body:** the committed self-test passes against the inline block (extracted from the YAML at `6390fe52`) and against the moved script. Negative control: with `--delete` dropped from the sync line, two checks go red.
- Each self-test carries a battery roster with per-case floors, a pinned roster size and a verdict handshake (AGENTS.md, "Writing a `--self-test`").

Derived gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gives 60 commands. Results are below. CI runs the rest.

**60 derived, 60 run, 0 red.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list` gives `60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. The first round had 4 reds, all caused by this diff and fixed in `b422bbdf`:

- `pnpm check:bash32-floor`: the R2 self-test's roster used `declare -A`. It now uses parallel indexed arrays.
- `node scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs` (and its `--self-test`): the new lint step ran its three self-tests as a bare sequence. It now uses the `run_self_test` collector.
- `pnpm check:declared-population-live`: the nightly self-test spelled its `$RUNNER_TEMP` fixture paths as literals, so they read as a declared population. It now builds them and carries a `no-path-population` marker.

Not in the derived list, run by hand: `bash scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.selftest.sh` passes (5 cases, 27 checks), and the new lint step's `run:` block, extracted from the YAML and run under `bash -e`, prints three `PASS` lines.

## Acceptance notes

**The card's premise holds for a minority of the volume.** On `6390fe52`: 20 inline bodies over 80 lines, 4,414 lines. Most of those lines are already exercised byte-for-byte by a gate that reads the YAML, so moving them buys no test reach and means rewriting the harness:

| Body (lines) | What already reads its bytes | Status |
|---|---|---|
| merge-queue-triage · Post the triage comment (901) | `check-merge-queue-triage-outcome.mjs` compiles it as github-script does, 28 mutations; its P0 also pins that the job holds no `contents:` grant, which a checkout for an import would need | stays |
| docs-drift-check · Comment on PR (597) | `docs-audit/check-drift-comment.mjs` runs it against fixture diffs | stays |
| cross-repo-issue-closer (416) | `check-cross-repo-closer-outcome.mjs` (executes), `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (mutates its regex) | stays |
| release.yml · Audit the release (277) | `release-verify-npm.mjs` batteries 12/13 run the step text | stays |
| merged-branch-reaper (174) | `check-merged-branch-reaper-outcome.mjs` (executes) | stays |
| shard-timings-refresh · Choose (82), Regenerate (136) | `ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs` runs both | stays |
| shard-timings-refresh · Compose (206) | text pin in `ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs` | stays |
| shard-timings-refresh · Push (102) | executed for real on every `pull_request` run of the lane (the `DRY_RUN` leg) | stays |
| pr-automation · Require a changeset (167) | text pins in `check-empty-changeset.mjs` | stays |
| platform-checklist-watchdog (145) | `check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs` scans the script for board writes; moving it would blind that negative pin | stays |
| duplicate-fix-guard (108) | `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` mutates its regex | stays |
| release.yml · Guard the approved release (99) | trust boundary: the `publish` job checks out the VERSION COMMIT, so a moved guard would be read from the tree it is guarding | stays |
| release.yml · Render (84), Validate (167) the post-version tree | trust boundary: both run after `changeset version` has written the working tree, so a moved validator would be read from the tree it validates | stays |
| ci.yml · Run this shard's tests (185) | the step #26084 is changing; moves after it lands | deferred |
| cut-rc.yml · Build the single version commit (164) | the file is deleted by #26196 | out |
| the three above | nothing | **moved here** |

After this PR: 17 bodies over 80 lines, 4,010 lines (the census re-run on the branch). Whether the harnessed bodies should move anyway, which means rewriting about ten harnesses and granting `contents: read` to jobs that hold none today, is the open scope question for this card's PR 1. It is in front of the maintainer in the project thread. This PR is the part both answers need.

## Verification

```sh
node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs --self-test
node scripts/ci/nightly-tiers-card.mjs --self-test
bash scripts/ci/board-snapshot-r2-upload.selftest.sh
```

Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`): draft until a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval (os-zhuang, hotlong).
